run_cpd_auto: run cpd_auto to detect change points in a video kernel matrix with automatic number selection
run_estimate_vmax: run estimate_vmax to compute the variance parameter from a stable segment kernel matrix
run_centering: run centering to apply kernel centering by subtracting row and column means from a kernel matrix
run_eval_score: run eval_score to evaluate the unnormalized empirical score for given change points on a kernel matrix
run_eval_cost: run eval_cost to evaluate the cost function for automatic change point selection with a penalty term
